problemSolution.headingHighlight: Your website should prove it in seconds.
problemSolution.subtitle: Most local and growing businesses lose high-intent prospects every day to slow, confusing websites. We replace guesswork with disciplined software engineering.
problemSolution.problemTitle: Why conventional websites fail to generate leads
problems: Bloated page-builder templates that take 5+ seconds to load on mobile, causing prospects to bounce before reading a single word.
Generic layouts that fail to communicate the true authority, reliability, and caliber of your business.
Zero visibility on Google due to broken semantic hierarchy, missing technical metadata, and poor Core Web Vitals.
Brochure-style pages with no clear conversion funnel—visitors arrive, don't see how to request a quote quickly, and leave.
problemSolution.solutionTitle: Software engineering built for commercial conversion
solutions: Extreme performance engineering (<2-second target mobile load) so you retain every prospect from the very first tap.
Executive dark-mode aesthetic crafted to position your company as the trusted authority in your market.
Root-level technical SEO (Schema.org, Core Web Vitals, Search Console) engineered to capture high-intent search demand.
Conversion-focused architecture designed around one goal: getting qualified prospects to message you on WhatsApp or request a quote.

whyUs.paragraph1: At Bazan & Co., we apply rigorous software engineering standards to every project. Unlike high-volume agencies that recycle sluggish templates, we build bespoke digital assets engineered to earn trust, project authority, and generate qualified commercial leads.
whyUs.paragraph2: Our Advanced English proficiency (iTEP Academic Plus) and Software Development Engineering background at UTCH BIS ensure seamless execution in both code quality and bilingual business communication.

items.question: How much does a custom website or landing page cost?
items.answer: Your investment depends on project scope (high-converting landing page, multi-section corporate site, or full ES/EN bilingual deployment). Following a free discovery call, we provide a fixed-price written proposal with zero hidden fees.
items.pendingNote: [PENDIENTE USUARIO: Starting price ranges per package if you wish to publish them]

items.question: How long will it take to launch my website?
items.answer: We work in clear weekly milestones (Discovery, Design, Engineering, and Launch) so you can review tangible progress from week one.
items.pendingNote: [PENDIENTE USUARIO: Estimated average delivery timeline in weeks]

items.question: Do I need technical or coding knowledge to work with you?
items.answer: Not at all. We handle 100% of the technical complexity—domain setup, hosting, SSL certificates, mobile speed optimization, SEO, and analytics—while communicating with you in clear business terms.

items.question: Do you only work with businesses in Chihuahua, or do you serve clients remotely?
items.answer: We are based in Chihuahua, Mexico, and partner remotely with businesses across Mexico, the United States, and Latin America in both Spanish and English.

items.question: How is Bazan & Co. different from a traditional WordPress or Wix agency?
items.answer: Generic visual page builders output heavy, slow code that hurts your rankings and limits growth. We use modern software engineering to achieve sub-2-second load times, superior security, and custom user flows built to convert visitors into leads.

items.question: Do you offer post-launch support or updates?
items.answer: Your website is delivered fully documented with Google Analytics 4 and Search Console active. We also provide direct technical support whenever your business needs new sections or updates.
